Choose one ally within 3 squares that can hear and understand you. Make a Guile roll. Choose Frightened or Dazed on the target. On a Standard result, reduce it by 1, and the target gains 1 Boon to its next roll to resist fear or Daze.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
Guile
Target / range / shape
One ally within 3 squares that can hear and understand you.
Duration
Immediate.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; normal action economy applies.
Type
Signature

Make a Guile roll. Choose Frightened or Dazed on the target. Weak: reduce that condition by 1. Standard: reduce it by 1, and the target gains 1 Boon to its next roll to resist fear or Daze. Strong: reduce it by 2, and the target gains 1 Boon to its next roll to resist fear or Daze. If the target has neither condition, it gains the Boon on a Standard or Strong result.
